=== REGISTERED COMPOUNDS ===

[Cocktails — CNY 35–55]
- Chungking Express: pineapple, lemon liqueur, lemon, gin, soda. Named after Wong Kar-wai's film.
- As Tears Go By: coffee liqueur, vodka, milk. Also a Wong Kar-wai reference.
- Shanghai Scoundrel: hawthorn, tequila, whiskey. Part of the "Scoundrel" series.
- Wuhan Scoundrel: gin, orange juice.
- Quanzhou Scoundrel: lapsang souchong tea, gin, tonic — smoky tea meets botanical spirit.
- Beijing Scoundrel: vodka, soda, raspberry, orange juice.
- Long Island Iced Tea: white rum, vodka, tequila, lemon, cola. Classic high-ABV construct.
- The Wizard of Oz: elderflower, kiwi, lemon juice. Low-ABV, floral.
- First Love: vodka, grape juice, strawberry milk. Sweet, nostalgic.
- Get Lost: gin, lemon juice, egg white. Crisp, frothy.
- Whiskey Sour: whiskey, lemon juice, egg white. Classic.
- Gin & Tonic: gin, tonic water, lemon. CNY 35.

[Sparkling — CNY 220–1080]
- Prosecco Spumante (Italy, Glera): light, fruity.
- Tingyun Pét-Nat series (Ningxia, China): Chardonnay blended with rose tea / jasmine tea / oolong tea. Pét-Nat = pétillant naturel, ancestral method — bottled before primary fermentation finishes, unfiltered, naturally fizzy. Tingyun (停云) is a virtual winery founded 2016 by Liu Jianjun, named after Tao Yuanming's poem.
- Moscato Spumante (Italy): sweet, low-ABV, peach and orange blossom.
- Prosecco Rosé (Veneto, Glera+Pinot Noir): red berry notes.
- Belvini Blanc de Noirs / Blanc de Blancs Champagne (France): traditional method, Pinot Noir/Meunier or Chardonnay.
- Pierre Gimonnet Special Club Blanc de Blancs (Côte des Blancs, Champagne): Chardonnay, grower Champagne, fine minerality.
- Moët & Chandon Brut Impérial: world's most recognized Champagne.
- Ruinart Blanc de Blancs (Reims, Champagne): oldest Champagne house (1729), Chardonnay.

[White Wine — CNY 180–780]
Key regions served:
- Chablis (Burgundy, France): 100% Chardonnay, Kimmeridgian limestone soil → chalky, oyster-shell minerality, unoaked, high acid.
- Sancerre / Pouilly-Fumé (Loire, France): 100% Sauvignon Blanc, flinty/smoky minerality, crisp.
- Mâconnais / Côte de Beaune (Burgundy): richer Chardonnay, often oak-aged.
- Marlborough (New Zealand): Sauvignon Blanc = passion fruit, gooseberry, grassy; also Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Riesling. Cool climate, sunny days, cold nights = ripe fruit + crisp acid. Misty Cove is a key producer on the menu.
- Ningxia (China): Helan Mountain east foothill, continental climate, high diurnal range. Tingyun, Tian Ding, Lianxi, Yuyanjia.
- Grüner Veltliner (Austria): white pepper, green apple, mineral.
- Etna (Sicily): volcanic soil, Carricante grape → citrus, saline minerality, high acid.
- Germany/Austria Riesling: from dry (troken) to off-dry, petrol notes with age.
- Vinho Verde (Portugal): light, slightly spritzy, low ABV.

[Red Wine — CNY 180–980]
Key regions:
- Burgundy (France): 100% Pinot Noir, elegant, earthy, red fruit. Hautes-Côtes-de-Nuits, Côte Chalonnaise.
- Beaujolais (France): 100% Gamay, light, fruity, Georges Duboeuf is iconic producer.
- Marlborough (New Zealand): Pinot Noir — cherry, plum, silky tannins, cool-climate vibrancy. Misty Cove "1203" and "Rock Daisy".
- Veneto (Italy): Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG — made via appassimento (grape drying for 100–120 days), concentrated, 15–17% ABV, Corvina/Rondinella/Molinara grapes. Ripasso = "baby Amarone" using Amarone pomace for second fermentation.
- Piemonte (Italy): Nebbiolo — Barolo and Barbaresco's grape, tar and roses, high tannin.
- Etna (Sicily): Nerello Mascalese — light-medium body, red fruit, volcanic minerality, "Mediterranean Burgundy".
- Ningxia (China): Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Pinot Noir from Helan Mountain. Tingyun "Red Beard" and Syrah.
- Australia: Shiraz (Syrah) — bold, jammy.

[BTG — By The Glass — CNY 30–198]
Whiskey (40ml pours):
- Macallan 12 Double Cask (Scotland, 40%): Speyside, sherry-seasoned oak.
- Macallan 12 Sherry Oak (Scotland, 40%): richer, dried fruit, spice.
- Lagavulin 16 (Islay, 43%): heavily peated, maritime, iodine, smoke. Islay's signature.
- Yamazaki 1923 (Japan, 43%): Japan's oldest malt distillery, delicate, floral, mizunara oak.
- Yamazaki 12 (Japan, 43%): deeper, more mizunara influence.
- Glenfarclas 15 (Highland, 46%): family-owned, sherry cask, rich and spicy.
Tequila:
- Agavales Gold (Mexico, 45%, 30ml).
Special:
- "A Shy Secret That Cannot Be Told" (China, 35%, 110ml, CNY 180): infused spirit.
Wine BTG (50ml pours):
- Vecchia Cantina Chianti DOCG 2019 (Italy, 13.5%, CNY 39).
- Librandi Asylia Bianco Melissa DOC 2020 (Italy, 12.5%, CNY 39).

[Tea — CNY 55–125]
All teas are full-leaf, served gongfu style.
Pu-erh Raw (生茶, sheng): sun-dried, pan-fried, compressed. Ages like wine — bitter young, smooth with age. "Snow-Whisking" (2019, orchid fragrance). "Biandao" (2021, Ice Island / 冰岛 origin — Yunnan's "Queen" of pu-erh, known for cooling sweetness,冰糖甜).
Pu-erh Ripe (熟茶, shou): pile-fermented (渥堆) for 45–60 days in 1973-invented process. Smooth, earthy, no bitterness. "7581" (1998, white paper edition — classic recipe from Kunming Tea Factory, aged aroma, medicinal notes). "Hehua Ancient Trees" (2018, ruby liquor, glutinous texture).
Yunnan Black Tea: "Wintersweet" (2021, 梅占 cultivar, honeyed, golden liquor).
Wuyi Black Tea (正山小种, Lapsang Souchong): origin of ALL black tea worldwide, Tongmu Pass, Wuyi Mountains. Pine-smoke dried → smoky, longan fruit notes. Amber liquor.
Wuyi Rock Tea (武夷岩茶, yancha): from Wuyi Mountains' unique Danxia landform (red sandstone). The concept of "岩韵" (yan yun, rock rhyme) = mineral backbone + floral complexity, only from this terroir. Oolong (semi-oxidized).
- Cassia (肉桂, Rougui): cinnamon/cassia bark aroma, creamy, stone fruit. "Heavy fragrance" style. Endures 6–7 infusions.
- Narcissus (水仙, Shuixian): from Huiyuan Keng (慧苑坑) — one of Wuyi's "Three Pits and Two Gullies" (三坑两涧), the most prized micro-terroirs. Old bush (老丛) character: orchid, aged wood, silky, strong throat resonance (喉韵).

=== GRID CONTEXT: JULU ROAD ===
397 Julu Road sits in Shanghai's former French Concession, part of the "Ju-Fu-Chang" (巨富长) triangle: Julu + Fumin + Changle Roads. The street was built 1907 as Rue Ratard. Now one of Shanghai's 64 "never-widen" roads.
Neighborhood character: plane trees (梧桐), 1920s–30s lane houses (里弄), garden villas, converted factories. By day: quiet, tree-lined, coffee shops and boutiques. By night: bars, live music, nightlife. Found 158 (大同坊) at 158 Julu is a sunken plaza with multiple clubs and bars.
Historical neighbors: Siming Village (四明邨, 626) — Xu Zhimo, Lu Xiaoman, Tagore all resided. Love Garden (爱神花园, 675–681) — 1931 Hudec-designed Renaissance mansion, now Shanghai Writers' Association.
JIUWO's location on Julu Road places it at ground level of one of Shanghai's most culturally layered grids — where 1930s literary salons and 2020s cocktail bars occupy the same coordinate space.
